scriptItem.label: Open Runtime Control
scriptItem.scriptCode: import sys, hou _root = hou.getenv("EEE_PATH") if not _root: raise RuntimeError("EEE_PATH not set. Run houdini_side/install_menu.py, then restart Houdini.") _l = _root + "/houdini_side" if _root not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0, _root) if _l not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0, _l) import secure_bridge_host, runtime_panel secure_bridge_host.start() runtime_panel.open_panel()
